nodes.title: Read me — there is no ControlNet here
widgets_values:
## The FLUX.2 API has no ControlNet

Build the control map locally with Canny and hand it to FLUX.2 as an ordinary reference image, because the API itself has no control endpoint to send it to.

`bfl_openapi.json` exposes only the flux-2-* generation endpoints, and their schemas carry no control fields — no canny endpoint, no depth endpoint, no control strength.

The FLUX.2 equivalent is to build the control map **locally** and hand it to the model as a *reference image*, then say in the prompt what that image is for. That is this graph:

**Load Image → Canny → input_image**

### Tuning
Watch the Preview under Canny. You want the structure readable and the noise gone — raise `low_threshold` to drop weak edges, lower it to keep more.

`guidance` (flex only, 1.5–10) is the adherence knob. Push toward 7–8 if the output wanders off the edge map; drop toward 3 if it looks stiff and traced.

`prompt_upsampling` is **off** so the structural instruction reaches the model intact.

### Depth instead of edges
Canny is ComfyUI core; depth is not. Install **comfyui_controlnet_aux**, drop in a `DepthAnythingV2Preprocessor`, feed Load Image into it, and connect its IMAGE output to `input_image` in place of Canny. Then rewrite the prompt's first line to describe a depth map — near is white, far is black — instead of edges.

### Plain image-to-image
Select the Canny node and press **Ctrl+B** to bypass it. Load Image then feeds `input_image` directly and you get an ordinary edit of the photo. Rewrite the prompt as an instruction — "change the ... to ..." — when you do.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds every `prompt` field in this graph, so there is one
place to edit and the copies cannot drift apart — the Canny-specific preamble and the scene description stay together in one place.

It emits a plain string, **not** a list. That is the difference between it and **Prompt
List**, which would make each node it feeds run once per line and multiply what the graph
costs.

nodes.title: FLUX.2 [flex] — follows the edges
widgets_values:
The reference image is a Canny edge map. Treat every white line in it as the exact structural blueprint for the scene: object boundaries, perspective, and proportions must follow those lines precisely. Do not draw the lines themselves in the output.

Render this scene onto that structure: a sunlit mid-century living room, low walnut sofa, large window, photorealistic, soft morning light, shallow depth of field.
